nodes.prompt:
You are the Single Main Background Run Orchestrator (Tier 2 Orchestrator) for implementing all research findings and optimizations across skills and gvui.

Repositories:
- skills: /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/skills
- gvui: /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui
Harness CLI: bun ~/.agents/skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/harness.ts
Capsule Directory: /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui/.capsules/2026-08-15-gvui-observability-findings-execution

### Core Directives & Standards:
1. You are the SOLE coordinator for all task execution. All worker and validator subagents you deploy must report strictly to you. Never report intermediate task progress to the main chat.
2. Reference the planning specifications:
   - skills/docs/planning/gvui-execution-graph/06-observability-findings-and-remediation-plan.md
   - skills/docs/planning/gvui-execution-graph/06-host-telemetry-and-agent-detection-plan.md
3. Initialize the run capsule:
   plan:init --repo /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui --run-id 2026-08-15-gvui-observability-findings-execution with prompt capture.
4. Add and execute tasks across parallel worker-validator pairs:
   - Task T-01 (Host Discovery & Token/Cache Telemetry in Skills):
     - Scope: skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/src/summary
     - Implement pluggable host telemetry (Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Cursor), parse model name + thinking level (e.g. Gemini 3.7 Flash (High)), parse inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheCreationTokens, cacheReadTokens, and costUsd.
     - Zero fallback fabrication: if undetected, return undefined.
     - Gate: bun test tests/unit/summary in skills.
   - Task T-02 (Canvas Rendering Performance Optimization in GVUI):
     - Scope: gvui/src/engine/GraphCanvas, gvui/src/engine/layout/custom
     - Optimize GraphBadgeLayer.tsx: use precalculated edge.badgeRect from layout engine; eliminate redundant per-frame O(E x N) collision loop.
     - Debounce saveStoredViewport in GraphCanvas/index.tsx so drag frames remain buttery smooth at 60–120 FPS.
     - Reusable singleton Web Worker in customLayoutWorkerClient.ts.
     - Gate: bun test src/engine/GraphCanvas && bun test src/engine/layout/custom in gvui.
   - Task T-03 (Node Internal Layout & Height Void Synchronization in GVUI):
     - Scope: gvui/src/engine/layout/measurement, gvui/src/primitives/nodes/NodeCard
     - Sync nodeTemplate.ts with NodeCard.css:
       - Set maxLines: 2 on description to match MAX_DESCRIPTION_LINES = 2 (eliminates 90px void).
       - Measure only rendered elements (single file summary chip, no body badges).
       - Set mini-chip itemChrome to 26 (matching CSS padding + border + icon + gap).
       - Set FONT_KEYS.nodeTitle to 13px in types.ts.
       - Header aside max-width: 60%; flex-shrink: 1; so title always gets full space.
     - Gate: bun test src/engine/layout/measurement && bun test src/primitives/nodes/NodeCard in gvui.
   - Task T-04 (Edge Badge Single-Line Measurement & Compactness Fix in GVUI):
     - Scope: gvui/src/engine/layout/customLayoutAdapter.ts, gvui/src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge
     - Measure composite single-line badge text (container.title ?? badge?.text ?? label) with +32px chrome in customLayoutAdapter.ts.
     - Ensure EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx uses Math.max(badgeRect?.width ?? 0, computedWidth) so badges never get squished.
     - Forward traffic, isHighTraffic, bundleCount in GraphBadgeLayer.tsx.
     - Gate: bun test src/primitives/edges in gvui.
   - Task T-05 (E2E Integration, WASM Layout Engine Verification & Manifest Registration):
     - Scope: gvui/public/data/graphs
     - Export final summary into public/data/graphs/2026-08-15-gvui-observability-findings-execution.json.
     - Update manifest.json.
     - Run WASM layout test suite bun test src/types/exampleGraphs.test.ts and full repo suite bun test src.
5. For each task:
   - Claim task with worker agent, submit report.
   - Dispatch independent validator with validation lease, run gate command with run:exec, perform adversarial invariant audit, resolve findings, and approve with task:review --status pass.
6. Run completion gate run:exec --gate gate-run-completion, completeness critic critic:start/critic:review, and seal capsule with run:complete.
7. Re-export summary so final JSON contains sealed status.
8. Format, commit, and push both repositories to origin/main.
9. Send a completion report only when 100% of the entire pipeline is complete and certified.
